summary: Comprehensive testing of Sistema de Descuentos y Pensiones Variables - All backend APIs (18/18 tests passed) and frontend UI components verified. Discount types CRUD, sibling detection, student discount assignment, pension calculation, and payment modal integration all working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/accounting/discount-types returns 4 seed discount types
Backend: POST /api/accounting/discount-types creates new manual discount type
Backend: POST /api/accounting/discount-types creates fixed amount discount
Backend: PUT /api/accounting/discount-types/{id} updates discount type
Backend: Duplicate discount name returns 409
Backend: Percentage > 100 returns 400
Backend: POST /api/accounting/discounts/sync syncs sibling discounts
Backend: GET /api/accounting/students/{id}/siblings returns sibling info
Backend: GET /api/accounting/students/{id}/discounts returns student discounts
Backend: GET /api/accounting/students/{id}/pension returns pension calculation with discount breakdown
Backend: POST /api/accounting/students/{id}/discounts assigns manual discount
Backend: Cannot manually assign automatic discount (400)
Backend: DELETE /api/accounting/students/{id}/discounts/{id} removes manual discount
Backend: Cannot remove automatic discount (400)
Backend: DELETE /api/accounting/discount-types/{id} fails if assigned to students (409)
Backend: DELETE /api/accounting/discount-types/{id} succeeds for unassigned types
Frontend: Configuracion tab loads with DiscountTypesSection and StudentDiscountsSection
Frontend: 4 seed discount types displayed (Descuento por hermanos, Primeros puestos, Bajos recursos, Beca completa)
Frontend: 'Descuento por hermanos' shows AUTOMATICO badge and '3 alumnos' count
Frontend: '+ Agregar descuento' button opens DiscountTypeModal
Frontend: DiscountTypeModal has all required fields (name, description, type, value, mode, active toggle)
Frontend: 'Sincronizar' button visible for automatic discounts
Frontend: StudentDiscountsSection search by grade/section/name works
Frontend: Pepito Peres Rios found and shows automatic sibling discount
Frontend: Sibling info displayed: 'Tiene 2 hermano(s) activo(s): Juan Lopez Zapata, Jorge Alamo Diaz'
Frontend: Pension calculation shows Base S/ 350.00, Discount -S/ 35.00, Final S/ 315.00
Frontend: Payment modal (Registrar Ingreso) opens correctly
Frontend: Payment modal shows student discounts when student is selected
Frontend: Payment modal displays 'Descuentos del alumno' section with discount breakdown
critical_code_review_comments: Backend discount system implementation is complete and well-structured
Sibling detection via parent_id/padre_id linkage working correctly
Automatic discount sync assigns discounts to all siblings in a family
Pension calculation correctly applies percentage and fixed amount discounts
Payment modal correctly loads and displays student pension with discounts

test_credentials.test_student: Pepito Peres Rios (has 2 siblings: Juan Lopez Zapata, Jorge Alamo Diaz)

seed_data_creation: 4 default discount types seeded automatically: Descuento por hermanos (10% automatic), Primeros puestos (15% manual), Bajos recursos (S/100 manual), Beca completa (100% manual)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discount system fully implemented and tested. Key endpoints: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/accounting/discount-types for CRUD, POST /api/accounting/discounts/sync for sibling discount sync, GET /api/accounting/students/{id}/discounts for student discounts, GET /api/accounting/students/{id}/pension for pension calculation, GET /api/accounting/students/{id}/siblings for sibling info. Frontend: Configuracion tab in Contabilidad page shows DiscountTypesSection and StudentDiscountsSection. Payment modal shows student discounts when student is selected. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_discount_system.py for regression testing.

backend.sibling_sync: POST /api/accounting/discounts/sync detects siblings via parent_id and assigns automatic discounts
backend.pension_calculation: GET /api/accounting/students/{id}/pension returns base, discounts, final pension
backend.sibling_info: GET /api/accounting/students/{id}/siblings returns parent and sibling details
backend.validation: Duplicate names (409), percentage > 100 (400), cannot assign automatic manually (400), cannot remove automatic (400), cannot delete assigned type (409)

frontend.discount_types_section: Shows 4 seed types with AUTOMATICO/MANUAL badges, assigned count, edit/delete buttons

frontend.sync_button: Triggers sibling discount sync for automatic discounts
frontend.student_discounts_section: Search by grade/section/name, shows automatic and manual discounts, pension calculation
